basic_details.short_information: Translational Health Science and Technology Institute (THSTI) has announced 1 vacancy for the Project Manager (Monitoring) post on a contract basis under advertisement number THS-C/RN/19/2026. Eligible candidates holding a Post Graduate Degree in any branch of Life Sciences with five (5) years post qualification experience in clinical trial monitoring OR PhD in any branch of Life Sciences with two (2) years post qualification experience in clinical trial can attend the walk-in interview. The notified pay for the post is Rs. 78,000 + HRA. Applicants should report for the walk-in interview on 28

age_limit.details: Upper age limit is Up to 45 years as of the date of interview.

post_wise_qualification.essential_qualification: • Post Graduate Degree, including integrated PG degrees, in any branch of Life Sciences with five (5) years post qualification experience in clinical trial monitoring. OR • PhD in any branch of Life Sciences with two (2) years post qualification experience in clinical trial monitoring.

qualification.details: Upper age limit is Up to 45 years as of the date of interview. | Experience of clinical trial or public health project management in a recognised organisation/institute (academic clinical trials unit, CRO, pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or device company). Demonstrable experience of line management, project management concepts, and ability to understand, explain and communicate project concepts using standard tools and templates.

rows.details: THSTI, NCR Biotech Science Cluster, 3rd Milestone, Faridabad-Gurugram Expressway, Faridabad – 121001

content_sections.heading: Posts and Eligibility
content_sections.text: Upper age limit is Up to 45 years as of the date of interview. Experience of clinical trial or public health project management in a recognised organisation/institute (academic clinical trials unit, CRO, pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or device company). Demonstrable experience of line management, project management concepts, and ability to understand, explain and communicate project concepts using standard tools and templates.

rows.qualification: • Post Graduate Degree, including integrated PG degrees, in any branch of Life Sciences with five (5) years post qualification experience in clinical trial monitoring. OR • PhD in any branch of Life Sciences with two (2) years post qualification experience in clinical trial monitoring.

content_sections.heading: What to Bring
content_sections.text: Latest CV/resume. One set of photocopies of documents in support of educational qualification and experience. Original documents for verification. Valid ID card for verification.

content_sections.heading: What Happens on the Day
content_sections.text: Candidates must arrive by 09:00 AM at the designated venue. Candidates must mandatorily deposit their mobile phone along with a valid identity proof at the reception upon arrival, which will be returned only upon completion of the entire selection process. Candidates coming after the scheduled time slot will not be entertained.

faq.question: Q1. Is this a permanent position?
faq.answer: No, these are short-term project positions, and extensions are granted subject to satisfactory performance of the incumbent and the tenure of the project. Appointed candidates will not have any claim for regularization of their employment.

faq.question: Q2. What is the age limit for the Project Manager (Monitoring) post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit is up to 45 years, with age relaxations applicable for reserved categories (SC, ST, OBC, PwBD, and others) as per Central Government and THSTI rules.

faq.question: Q3. Are allowances paid in addition to the consolidated emoluments?
faq.answer: The notified emoluments are Rs. 78,000/- per month plus House Rent Allowance (HRA).

faq.question: Q4. What are the reporting requirements on the day of the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must bring their latest CV, original and photocopied documents, and a valid ID card. All candidates are mandatorily required to deposit their mobile phones and valid identity proof at the reception upon arrival.
